name: pche_htc
title: Printed-circuit heat exchanger (PCHE): channel heat-transfer coefficient correlations (function library)
summary: EES FUNCTIONs for the convective heat-transfer coefficient in the semicircular channels of a printed-circuit heat exchanger (sCO2 recuperators): straight channel (Stephan-Preusser laminar and Gnielinski transition on the semicircle hydraulic diameter) and the bending-angle zigzag fits of PCHE_Lee with their friction-factor fit (recommended, alpha <= 40 deg for Re <= 2000). The zigzag formula of PCHE_conv is not physical in the original and returns -1; wavy and airfoil channels are not implemented in the original.

authors: S. W. Lee, S. M. Shin, S. Chung, H. Jo (PCHE_conv reference)
Y. Jiang, E. Liese, S. E. Zitney, D. Bhattacharyya (PCHE_Lee reference)
Y. Lee, S. Lee, H. B. Park, K. W. Seo, D. Lee (PCHE_Lee reference)

verification.summary: Compared with a re-run of PCHE_conv (straight) and PCHE_Lee of LaboThapPy 0.1.0 (commit f03f7f47) in a throw-away venv: 27 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), largest relative deviation 4.0e-13. Publications not checked; the non-physical zigzag formula of PCHE_conv is not shipped (returns -1).
verification.reference: LaboThapPy printed_circuit_htc.py (PCHE_conv straight, PCHE_Lee) called with the demonstration inputs in a throw-away virtualenv (pip install of the local clone, CoolProp 8.0.0)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 27 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest relative deviation 4.0e-13 (h_L[8]), round-off of the 13 digits of the .sol. The friction fit f_L is a local variable of the original; checked with a separate Python line (alpha = 5, 15, 35 deg). The zigzag branch of PCHE_conv (h ~ 1e13 W/m2-K) was reproduced before being withdrawn.
